## What I did

Describe the workflow approach you tried.

## How long you used it

Critical field. Patterns less than a month old are not yet failure-tested.

## What happened

What broke down? Be specific:
- "Memory grew to X size and became unsearchable"
- "Cron jobs collided after Y weeks"
- "Lost work in a context switch"

## Why it failed (your hypothesis)

What was the underlying reason? Not just the symptom.

## What you do instead

Concrete current pattern that's working.

## Why this fits the four-layer architecture

Which layer (state / memory / skills / workflows) does this anti-pattern relate to?
